scientific_limitations_and_integrity.domain: Two agents, scalar strongly convex quadratic local objectives, complete averaging, and the main local-gradient stepsize rule.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: The indexed closest-result comparison was available as a summary, not full text; this is retained as a residual originality risk.
limitations: No result is claimed for larger networks, nonlinear objectives, multidimensional Hessians, or alternative stepsize candidates.
The initial local smoothness estimates must be well-defined.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proof_basis: Exact recurrence derivation plus the necessary-and-sufficient real quadratic Schur/Jury criterion; symbolic determinant and rational boundary tests are reproducible in verify.py.

title: An exact stability frontier for curvature-adaptive gradient tracking
